questions.prompt: Which API suits a small text draft that should survive recreation?
questions.explanation: A saveable draft can be stored in instance state and reconstructed with the destination.

questions.prompt: remember is durable storage after process death.
questions.explanation: remember lasts only while its composition identity remains alive.

questions.prompt: Where should state read and changed by two siblings normally live?
questions.explanation: One coordinating owner prevents duplicated and inconsistent state.

questions.prompt: Reusable leaf content should normally receive MutableState directly.
questions.explanation: Plain values and intent callbacks provide a narrower and testable contract.

questions.prompt: Which key preserves a note row after sorting?
questions.explanation: A stable unique domain ID follows the same item across positions.

questions.prompt: Correctness may depend on a composable running exactly once.
questions.explanation: Execution count is not a semantic guarantee of the Compose runtime.

questions.prompt: Which key suits reorderable note rows?
questions.explanation: Domain identity preserves item state when positions change.

questions.prompt: An unbounded vertical LazyColumn inside verticalScroll is a safe default.
questions.explanation: Same-axis scrolling can create infinite constraints and competing gesture ownership.
